facts.fact: Afribone Mali says its modernised data centre was inaugurated in mid-2019 with the arrival of a first large client, and it offers colocation and data storage services.

MLI.note: Names only foreign exchanges (FranceIX, AMS-IX, WAFIX Lagos) where Afribone peers; no exchange in Mali.
Mentions power cuts and solar backup but gives no outage count.

facts.fact: Afribone Mali says its international links run over optical fibre through Dakar and Abidjan to the ACE and MainOne submarine cables.
facts.system: Afribone international links via Dakar and Abidjan

MLI.note: Document does not state the data centre's ownership.

facts.fact: Afribone Mali says its international links run over fibre via Dakar (Senegal) and Abidjan (Cote d'Ivoire) to the submarine cables ACE and MainOne.
facts.system: Afribone fibre links via Dakar and Abidjan

MLI.note: Only says Afribone ended its VSAT link in 2008; no satellite broadband on sale.
